questions.q: What is a segment in Data Cloud (Data 360)?
options: A raw copy of a source table
A metric such as lifetime value
A saved population of unified profiles that meet defined conditions
A schedule for refreshing a data stream
questions.explain: A segment is a filtered group of unified profiles. A metric would be a calculated insight, and a refresh schedule belongs to a data stream.

questions.q: How does a segment differ from a calculated insight?
options: A segment returns the member profiles; a calculated insight returns aggregated measures by dimension
They are identical; the names are interchangeable
A segment can only be built with SQL
A calculated insight returns members while a segment returns sums
questions.explain: Segments define who is in a group. Calculated insights compute metrics per group of dimensions.

questions.q: In the segment builder, what is the difference between direct and related attributes?
options: Direct attributes are private; related attributes are public
Direct attributes belong to the object the segment is on; related attributes come from connected objects such as orders
Direct attributes are always numbers; related attributes are always text
There is no difference
questions.explain: Direct attributes are on the base object (such as Individual). Related attributes come from connected objects like sales orders or engagement events.

questions.q: Why can it matter whether two conditions sit in one container or in separate containers?
options: It changes only the color of the canvas
Containers control the publish schedule
Separate containers always double the population
Conditions in one container apply to the same related record, while separate containers can be met by different records
questions.explain: Grouping changes the meaning of the logic, so verify a new segment against a few known profiles.

questions.q: A newly built segment shows a much smaller population than expected. Which cause fits what this course has taught so far?
options: Segments always show half the real population
A field used in the filter was not mapped, or identity resolution merged or missed profiles
Tableau Desktop has not been installed
The segment was named incorrectly
questions.explain: Only mapped fields are usable, and identity resolution rules affect which profiles exist. Both can silently distort a population.
